sheets.title: LEGEND, ABBREVIATIONS, AND PANELBOARD SCHEDULE
sheets.reading_notes: Cover/legend sheet. Contains electrical legend (light fixture symbols, receptacle types, panelboard symbol, homerun callouts, conduit notation), abbreviations list (AMP, CONDUIT, DISCONNECT, EXISTING, GROUND, LIGHTING, MCB, MLO, PANELBOARD, PHASE, SWITCH, TYPICAL, VOLT/VOLTAGE, TRANSFORMER), and general notes referencing NFPA, NEC, and VUSBC. Main content is 'Typical Panelboard MDP Schedule': 125A MCB, 125A main circuit breaker, 120/240V, 1-phase, 3-wire, 10 kAIC minimum, recessed mount. Manufacturer: Homeline HOM2448M125-PC-HOM INGR. Load schedule lists living room receptacles and lighting, bedroom receptacles and lighting, spare circuits, dishwasher (10A), washing machine (10A), dryer (4VAC, 30A), range (50A), microwave (8A), bathroom receptacles and lighting. Total connected: A=113A, B=103.5A. Sheet title block shows 'NORFOLK, VA' in vertical border text, BFA stamp dated 6-25-20, project 20-049, sheet 1 of 6.

sheets.title: OVERALL FLOOR PLANS — DEMOLITION
sheets.reading_notes: Two overall demolition floor plans at 1/8"=1'-0" scale: 1307 W Little Creek (top) and 1301 W Little Creek (bottom). Both show long single-story-footprint row buildings with multiple dwelling units side by side — visible from unit door/window layout. Demolition notes: (1) exterior lights existing to remain; (2) disconnect meter center and remove all associated devices, conduit, and wiring complete back to source; (3) disconnect and remove panel and all associated wiring and devices back to source. Existing electrical infrastructure in each unit is being fully removed. Exterior lighting remains. Scale and layout suggest each building is a 2-story structure (the 'overall' plan is a single-floor outline plan).

sheets.title: TYPICAL FLOOR PLANS — DEMOLITION
sheets.reading_notes: Two typical unit floor plans at 1/2"=1'-0" scale: typical first story and typical second story. Unit plans show bathroom, bedroom, living area, and kitchen spaces. Electrical devices shown as existing-to-be-removed (dashed or light-weight symbols per legend). Demolition note: disconnect and remove panel and feeder wiring and conduit back to source. Two-story building confirmed. First and second floor unit layouts appear identical or very similar from the typical plan comparison.

sheets.title: OVERALL FLOOR PLANS — NEW WORK AND PANEL RISER DIAGRAM
sheets.reading_notes: Two overall new-work floor plans at 1/8"=1'-0" for 1307 (top) and 1301 (bottom). New devices shown in heavy lineweight. Construction notes: (1) exterior lights existing to remain; (2) provide new meter center, connect existing Dominion Power to new meter center, connect new conduits and wirings to new typical panels 'MDP', see meter center riser diagram on sheet E-501; (3) see typical panel riser diagram on this sheet. Typical Panel Riser Diagram (no scale) shows 4 panels total — two per building (one per floor): 125A 120/240V Panel 'MDP' on 1st and 2nd floor for each of 1301 and 1307. Panels connected via wire chase with two #1/0 and #6 GND (typ). Connect wire chase to new meter center; each panel 'MDP' will connect to a 125A 2P QO breaker — see sheet E-501 for additional information. Note: Sheet E-501 referenced but not present in the 4-sheet PDF (file is 1 of 6 but only 4 sheets provided).
